# Compute the longest streak of "yes" for limited_screen_time_to_1_hr
# notes are in order from newest (1521) to oldest (1534)
# We'll extract the value for each note and compute consecutive "yes" streak
values = []
for note in notes:
    content = note['content']
    # Find the line for limited_screen_time_to_1_hr
    for line in content.split('\n'):
        if line.startswith('limited_screen_time_to_1_hr:'):
            val = line.split(': ')[1].strip()
            values.append(val)
            break

# values are in order from newest to oldest
# We need to compute longest consecutive "yes" streak
max_streak = 0
current_streak = 0
for v in values:
    if v == 'yes':
        current_streak += 1
        if current_streak > max_streak:
            max_streak = current_streak
    else:
        current_streak = 0

print("Values (newest to oldest):", values)
print("Longest streak:", max_streak)
